paite: TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a,
heading: Galtai A Om Bang Limching Zawlnei
english: Yahweh’s word also came to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, helhat inkuan, muhna ding mit nei a mu lou, zakna ding bil nei a zaloute lak a om na hi; helhat inkuan ahih himhim ziak un.
english: “Son of man, you dwell in the middle of the rebellious house, who have eyes to see, and don’t see, who have ears to hear, and don’t hear; for they are a rebellious house.

paite: "Huaiziak in nang mihing tapa, saltanna a pai ding bang in na vante lomgak dimdiam inla, sun khovak ah amitmuh mahmah un paikhia in; amuh mahmah na mun ua kipan mun dang ah na paikhe ding ahi; helhat inkuan ahi ua, akingaihtuah loh kha mai ding uh.
english: “Therefore, you son of man, prepare your baggage for moving, and move by day in their sight. You shall move from your place to another place in their sight. It may be they will consider, though they are a rebellious house.

paite: Huan na van sun khovak in amitmuh mahmah uah, saltang pai ding van lakkhiak in na lakhe ding a, nang mahmah leng amitmuh uah gamdang a khakmang ding pai in na pai ding ahi.
english: You shall bring out your baggage by day in their sight, as baggage for moving. You shall go out yourself at evening in their sight, as when men go out into exile.

paite: Amitmuh mahmah uah kulhbaang vangsak inla, huai ah lakhia in.
english: Dig through the wall in their sight, and carry your baggage out that way.

paite: Amitmuh mahmah uah na po ding a, mial ah na paikhe ding a, lei na muhlouhna ding in na mai na khuh ding ahi; Israel inkote a ding in etsak kholhna ding in nang ka hon bawl ahi ngal a," achi hi.
english: In their sight you shall bear it on your shoulder, and carry it out in the dark. You shall cover your face, so that you don’t see the land, for I have set you for a sign to the house of Israel.”

paite: Huchi in ahon thupiak bang in ka hihta a, ka van saltang ding van bang in sun khovak in ka lakhia a, ka khut in baang ka sunvang a, khomial lai in ka lakhia a, amitmuh mahmah uah ka pua hi.
english: I did so as I was commanded. I brought out my baggage by day, as baggage for moving, and in the evening I dug through the wall with my hand. I brought it out in the dark, and bore it on my shoulder in their sight.

paite: Huan zingsang in ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung hi.
english: In the morning, Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: Mihing tapa, Israel inkuan, helhat inkuante'n na kiang ah, "Bang hih na hia?" ahon chi uh ahi kei maw?
english: “Son of man, hasn’t the house of Israel, the rebellious house, said to you, ‘What are you doing?’

paite: Akiang uah, "Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Hiai thuphuan Jerusalem heutute leh Israel inkote pumpi, a-omna uh mite tungthu ding ahi.
english: “Say to them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “This burden concerns the prince in Jerusalem, and all the house of Israel among whom they are.”’

paite: Nou a ding in etsak kholhna ka hi a, ka chih bang geih a atung ua hih ahi ding; khakmang in, saltang ding in apaimang ding uh," chi in.
english: “Say, ‘I am your sign. As I have done, so will it be done to them. They will go into exile, into captivity.

paite: "Huan alak ua heutu omsun in mial nuai ah aliang in apo ding a, apaikhe ding; alakkhiakna ding un baang avangsak ua, amit in gam amuh nawn louh ziak in amai akhuh ding ahi.
english: “‘The prince who is among them will bear his baggage on his shoulder in the dark, and will go out. They will dig through the wall to carry things out that way. He will cover his face, because he will not see the land with his eyes.

paite: Amah ka len in ka khuh ding a, ka thang a awk ahi ding; Kaldai gam a Babulon ah ka hon pi ding a, muh zaw amu kei ding; huai ah asi ding hi.
english: I will also spread my net on him, and he will be taken in my snare. I will bring him to Babylon to the land of the Chaldeans; yet he will not see it, though he will die there.

paite: Amah panpih dia akiang a omte leh asepaihte tengteng gam chih ah ka hihzak ding a, namsau dokkhia in ka delh ding hi.
english: I will scatter toward every wind all who are around him to help him, and all his bands. I will draw out the sword after them.

paite: "Huan namte lak a ka delhzak a, gam chih a ka hihdalh hun chiang in TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding uh.
english: “‘They will know that I am Yahweh when I disperse them among the nations and scatter them through the countries.

paite: Himahleh namsau, kial, hipi a kipan mi tawmchik ka hawi ding; huaite'n ahong paina gam ua namte kiang ah akihhuaina tengteng aphuanna ding un; kei TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding uh," achi hi.
english: But I will leave a few men of them from the sword, from the famine, and from the pestilence, that they may declare all their abominations among the nations where they come. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.’”

paite: Huan ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung nawn hi.
heading: Zawlnei Linna
english: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, na an ling vonvon kawm in ne inla, na tui lungzing a ling kawm in dawn in.
english: “Son of man, eat your bread with quaking, and drink your water with trembling and with fearfulness.

paite: Huan gam a mite kiang ah Toupa PATHIAN in Jerusalem a tengte tungtang ah leh Israel gam tungtang ah hichi in achi: Lau kawm in a-ante uh ane ding ua, lungzingtak in atui uh adawn ding ua, agamsung a tengte hiamgamna ziak in asung a thil om tengteng a kipan hihgawp in a-om ding hi.
english: Tell the people of the land, ‘The Lord Yahweh says concerning the inhabitants of Jerusalem and the land of Israel: “They will eat their bread with fearfulness and drink their water in dismay, that her land may be desolate, and all that is therein, because of the violence of all those who dwell therein.

paite: Huchi in mite tenna khopite loihsan in a-om ding a, agam hihsiat in a-om ding; huchi in TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding uh," achi hi.
english: The cities that are inhabited will be laid waste, and the land will be a desolation. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.”’”

paite: Huan ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung hi:
heading: Paunak Minthang Leh Limsak Louh Thugen
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, Israel gam a hiai paunak na neih uh bang chihna ahia? Anite asawt chiang in kilakna peuhmah avuaksuak nawn zel," na chih uh.
english: “Son of man, what is this proverb that you have in the land of Israel, saying, ‘The days are prolonged, and every vision fails’?

paite: Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Hiai paunak ka hihbei ding a, Israel gam ah azang nawn ngei kei ding uh; kilakna tundik ni ding anaita, chi in akiang uah gen zaw in.
english: Tell them therefore, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “I will make this proverb to cease, and they will no more use it as a proverb in Israel;”’ but tell them, ‘“The days are at hand, and the fulfillment of every vision.

paite: "Israel inkuante lak ah kilakna hong vuaksuak leh aisan hoih lam a maitang phatna a-omta kei ding.
english: For there will be no more any false vision nor flattering divination within the house of Israel.

paite: TOUPA ka hi a, ka gen ding a, ka gen tangtun ahi ding a, sit ahi kei ding; Aw helhat inkuante aw, na dam lai mahmah un thu ka gen ding hi, ka tangtungsak pah ding, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi," achi hi.
english: For I am Yahweh. I will speak, and the word that I speak will be performed. It will be no more deferred; for in your days, rebellious house, I will speak the word and will perform it,” says the Lord Yahweh.’”

paite: TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a,
english: Again Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, ngai in, 'Israel inkote a min kilakna amuhte bel ni tampi a ding ahi a, agenkholhte leng gamlapi a ding ahi,' " achi uhi.
english: “Son of man, behold, they of the house of Israel say, ‘The vision that he sees is for many days to come, and he prophesies of times that are far off.’

paite: Huaiziak in akiang uah, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Ka thu bangmah sit ahi kei ding a, ka thugen peuhmah hihtangtun in a-om zaw ding, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi, chi in hilh in,” achi hi.
english: “Therefore tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “None of my words will be deferred any more, but the word which I speak will be performed,” says the Lord Yahweh.’”
